vc_checking.summary: All 37 current manual obligations are semantically provable. The @pre rewrite keeps circular_area_pre, output_buffer_pre, and data_length_pre connected to the live resources and branch facts in every CircularAreaRead return VC; state, output_before, and output_capacity also remain shared. Therefore return_wit_1/2 have no independently quantified snapshot gap. Existing proved case-library lemmas cover query normalization, ring arithmetic, initialized slices, logical-state consumption, and physical splitting; no new helper or annotation change is required.

witness_judgments.summary: Unfold store_circular_area, reuse its hidden representation witnesses, project its pure facts, and cancel the exact descriptor/backing resources.
readidx<>writeidx gives full-result 0 by CircularArea_full_read_ne; unchanged resources fold back into store_circular_area.
b_status=0 gives full-result 0 by CircularArea_full_status_zero; spatial ownership is unchanged.
equal indices and nonzero status give full-result 1 by CircularArea_full_status_nonzero.
Unfold store_circular_area and instantiate the generated existential representation with the same hidden values.
readidx<>writeidx gives empty-result 0 by CircularArea_empty_read_ne and the store repacks directly.
nonzero status excludes empty by CircularArea_empty_status_nonzero; resources are preserved.
equal indices with zero status imply nil contents by CircularArea_empty_status_zero_equal.
CircularAreaLogicalState supplies positive capacity, hence the divisor is nonzero.
Both indices lie in [0,capacity) with capacity<=256, so writeidx-readidx is within signed-int bounds.
A nonzero full-query result forces Zlength contents=capacity; store expansion provides the requested resources.
A zero full-query result excludes equality; the logical-state upper bound strengthens this to length<capacity.
Normalize the bounded unsigned ring sum and apply CircularArea_data_length_mod to obtain the logical length.
The full branch assumes Zlength contents=capacity, exactly the requested data-length result.
Select the store-owning disjunct; store_circular_area at address zero is inconsistent because its body requires a non-null address.
Store expansion plus readidx<capacity<=256 and requested<=logical_length<=capacity proves readidx+requested<=UINT_MAX.
Normalize the bounded uint32 sum; the >capacity guard selects concrete result 1, and state validity/length bounds establish the abstract result.
Normalize the bounded uint32 sum; the <=capacity guard selects result 0 and logical state supplies abstract validity.
Unfold CircularAreaReadInput and distribute its exact null-area, null-output, and valid-output alternatives.
CircularAreaStateEmptyResult plus retval<>0 fixes retval=1; store/output resources remain unchanged.
Both data-length observations equal Zlength contents; requested>length makes actual=length, empty-result 0 makes it positive, and nonzero divide result fixes result 1.
requested<=observed logical length makes Z.min requested length=requested; the nonzero divide result selects the wrap branch.
For the wrap tail copy, normalize capacity-readidx, split both mixed arrays, and use CircularAreaInitializedSlice_nonwrap.
For the wrap head copy, use read_len_down=actual-read_len_up, CircularAreaInitializedSlice_wrap_head, and split the remaining segments.
The nonwrap divide relation yields readidx+actual<=capacity; the nonwrap initialized-slice lemma and array splitting supply memcpy resources.
Same nonwrap proof with actual=requested, obtained from requested<=Zlength contents.
Join wrap output pieces, consume the FIFO prefix, normalize the wrapped index, and construct the success disjunct of CircularAreaReadResult.
Join nonwrap physical/output segments, consume the logical prefix, and construct success at new index (readidx+actual) mod capacity.
EmptyResult=1 means contents=nil; choose state_after=state and output_after=output_before in the unchanged error disjunct.
requested<=0 and 0<=requested force requested=0, so the unchanged error disjunct applies.
CircularAreaErrorResult 1 unfolds to reflexivity; the live store resource is unchanged.
CircularAreaErrorResult 1 is immediate and GlobalStrings cancels unchanged in the null-area branch.
CircularAreaStateDataLengthResult rewrites retval to Zlength contents, yielding both requested bounds.
Rewrite retval_2 to Zlength contents and use requested<=retval_2 plus the existing nonnegative bound.
Wrap-tail sublist lengths follow from read_len_up=capacity-readidx, read_len_up<=actual<=logical length, and actual<=output_capacity.
Wrap-head sublist lengths follow from read_len_down=actual-read_len_up, read_len_down<=readidx, and logical/output bounds.
Nonwrap sublist lengths follow from 0<=actual, actual<=logical length, and actual<=output_capacity.

natural_language_analysis.method: Every target was checked as P |-- Q in the current goal file. Spatial ownership, pure facts, existential instantiation, and refinement state were considered separately. Diagnostics were hint-only.

snapshot_bridge.finding: CircularAreaRead return_wit_1/2 use the same @pre values in their antecedent resources/branch facts and CircularAreaReadResult conclusion. No second unrelated address, request, state, or output snapshot is quantified.
snapshot_bridge.premise_discharge: The antecedent owns descriptor fields at circular_area_pre and output segments at output_buffer_pre, carries the actual-length relation from data_length_pre, and retains state/output_before/output_capacity, exactly matching Q.
